summary.headline: Astrological Chapter Catalogue, 73–93
summary.text: Catalog entries 73–93 for a Venetian astrological codex, covering arts, manumission, exaltations and depressions, terms, parallax, zodiacal signs, decans, nodes, buying, childlessness, and animal purchases, with cross-references to Florentine and other codices. The decan section cites Porphyry’s Introduction.
